quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Abstract
quest.description: Assist the researcher from Sumeru in initializing the Pursina's Spike to clear the dark mud from the mining complex of The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The effects are better than I thought! We've recorded all the phenomena we've seen and the data we've collected...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: And most importantly, the dark mud was completely cleared.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, why do you look so unhappy? Is it a bad thing that the mining complex is all clean?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Let me think... Well, when Khedive and I analyzed the situation previously, we believed that the opening in the Ley Lines through which the dark mud came should be here.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I don't think that such an opening would have been this easy to clear out, so the true entry point must be elsewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: And in this case, the affected areas also include...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Exactly, this means that the point through which the dark mud is flowing in is in the tunnels. Such areas will be far more narrow, allowing for greater buildup of the mud, and making it easier for monsters to swarm in, thus worsening our problem.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Still, I have full faith in the Pursina's Spike.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: It is, after all, Pursina's great creation.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Just let me do a bit of maintenance work on it first. I'll call the miners who've agreed to move the Spike into the tunnels over.
